children: have expanded their artificial intelligence infrastructure partnership in Saudi Arabia, bringing a jointly developed platform into live operation with HUMAIN.

The system combines AMD Instinct MI355X graphics processors and EPYC central processors with Cisco networking equipment. HUMAIN will use the platform to provide computing capacity for AI model development and deployment, including training and inference workloads.

Cisco's N9000 Series, Silicon One technology and 800G optical equipment connect the GPU systems through a network designed to support large-scale AI computing. The companies said the deployment is part of efforts to establish an open AI infrastructure ecosystem in the kingdom.

The partners expect the next phase to add as much as 250 megawatts of capacity starting in 2027. Their broader joint venture remains positioned to reach up to one gigawatt of AI infrastructure by 2030, supported by customer demand.
The Saudi expansion could provide AMD with another avenue for selling AI accelerators and data-center processors as regional infrastructure spending increases.

title: AMD and Cisco Expand AI Infrastructure in Saudi Arabia
